html:
SMTO-CFG-0023 — SMTO couldn't save that change to the message box settings

GUID: 35abee21-5799-4956-89e9-39be7d88badb
Slug: composer-patch-invalid
Domain: CFG · Subsystem: cfg

What happened

  • The setting you just changed above the message box has a value SMTO can't accept, for example an Output limit below your model's minimum. SMTO didn't save the change.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Look at the control you just changed. For Output limit, select Default or move the slider higher; for other controls, pick a different option. The value you just chose is the one SMTO refused, and each control only accepts certain values.
  2. If the error stays, reload the page, then make the change again. The page keeps the refused value as unsaved until you replace it or reload.

What success looks like

  • The message above the message box clears, and your change is still there after you reload the page.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it, with the name of the control you changed, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't keep selecting Retry settings; it resends the same refused value.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The composer profile change was rejected because the merged profile failed ConversationComposerProfile validation or max_completion_tokens was below the current output_token_min.

What this means

  • Merging a composer patch fails the profile schema or requests max_completion_tokens below the current output-token minimum. Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.

Why this can happen

  • Merging a composer patch fails the profile schema or requests max_completion_tokens below the current output-token minimum.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect changed field types/ranges and the effective output-token minimum before saving.

How to fix it

  • Check the changed fields against ComposerValues (allowed option values, reasoning percent 0–100, max_completion_tokens at least output_token_min, gateway_id equal to the primary Gateway, a valid agent/collaboration mode pair) and resubmit only the corrected fields with the current expected_revision.
  • Correct the selected preference using its advertised values before saving.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The merged profile validates with the intended supported values.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Validation reports the owning configuration boundary; it does not change settings, migrate retained state or grant authority. Existing tasks retain their accepted snapshots unless the specific control explicitly supports a live change.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
